name: Contribution Profit
definition: Net revenue minus variable costs over the period.

name: Variable Costs
definition: Orders times unit variable cost (COGS + fulfillment + payment).

name: Sessions
definition: New sessions plus returning sessions over the period.

name: Returning Sessions
definition: Sessions from known visitors. Driven (illustratively) by email capture rate.

name: Conversion Rate
definition: Orders divided by sessions; product of the four funnel-stage rates.

name: Product View Rate
definition: Share of sessions viewing at least one product page.

name: Add to Cart Rate
definition: Share of product viewers who add an item to cart.

name: Checkout Start Rate
definition: Share of cart adds that begin checkout.

name: Purchase Completion Rate
definition: Share of checkout starts that complete purchase.

name: Cost per Order
definition: Variable cost per fulfilled order (COGS + ship + payment).

name: Email Capture Rate
definition: Share of new sessions yielding an email opt-in.

name: Page Load Speed (s)
definition: Median page load duration in seconds.

name: Loyalty Membership Rate
definition: Share of customers enrolled in the loyalty program. WARNING: high LTV correlation is likely selection, not causation. Heavy buyers self-select into programs; the program does not manufacture heavy buyers. Requires a randomized enrollment experiment to isolate lift.

name: Customer LTV
definition: Long-run contribution per customer (informational; not in current period identity).
assumptions: average_order_value (modeled, elasticity 0.6, grade illustrative); loyalty_membership (hypothesized increases, grade none)
